newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent crude recovers as Iraq opens fire again.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent crude recovers as Iraq opens fire again.

text.p: IPE Brent crude oil futures swung back into the black again after Iraq said it had fired three missiles at U.S. and allied warplanes patrolling the no-fly zone in southern Iraq, brokers said.

From a low of $23.35, October Brent recovered to $23.75 per barrel by 1544 GMT, 17 cents above Wednesday's close. But prices were still well short of their post-Gulf War high of $24.39 reached earlier in the day.
Iraqi state television, quoting a military spokesman, said its air defence systems fired three missiles on Thursday morning against "hostile targets, forcing them to flee."
